description: This file contains smoke tests for verifying that the OpenAPI documentation endpoints of the backend API are accessible and returning expected results. It uses Spring Boot testing framework with a real embedded server, mocking certain beans to avoid database dependencies.

classes.name: OpenApiDocsSmokeTest
classes.description: A test class that performs smoke testing on the OpenAPI documentation endpoints to ensure they return valid responses.

methods.name: v3ApiDocsShouldReturn200
methods.description: Test method that calls the '/v3/api-docs' endpoint and asserts the response status code is 200 and the body contains the 'openapi' field.
